Primary setting: Pearson correlation across 94 shared informative genes
Alternative setting: Spearman correlation; cosine similarity; Pearson correlation after removing the 6 NC3 source markers
Key result: REC ranked first in all four analyses; REC similarity ranged from 0.335 to 0.388 and its margin over the next state ranged from 0.148 to 0.217
Reader-facing interpretation: The closest-reference-state interpretation did not depend on one similarity metric or the six annotation markers

Key result: REC was the top state in 93.62% of bootstrap samples, the REC-minus-second-state margin was positive in 100%, and REC ranked first after every single-gene omission
Reader-facing interpretation: No individual mapping gene determined the REC assignment

Alternative setting: Published 33-marker programmes for ten source epithelial states
Key result: The published REC programme ranked first in bulk HGP data (difference 0.612) and second in lesion-size data (0.479); the published hypoxia programme ranked first for lesion size (0.514)
Reader-facing interpretation: External axes favour the REC state while lesion size additionally carries a strong hypoxia component

Primary setting: Fixed programme among 44 genes measurable on both external axes
Key result: Observed effects were 0.498 in bulk HGP and 0.337 for lesion size; empirical P was 0.000999 for each axis and jointly
Reader-facing interpretation: The joint external association was not reproduced by equally expressed random gene sets

Key result: Bulk HGP effects ranged from 0.502 to 0.614 and paired lesion-size effects from 0.305 to 0.374; all two-sided P values were at most 0.0195
Reader-facing interpretation: The main directions were not specific to choosing exactly 50 genes

Primary setting: At least 150 detected genes, mitochondrial fraction at most 70%, and at least 20 tumour or epithelial cells per patient
Key result: Among settings retaining the same five patients, the equal-gene rHGP-minus-dHGP effect ranged from 0.255 to 0.397
Reader-facing interpretation: The small epithelial cohort retained the same positive direction across compatible QC settings

Alternative setting: 1000 iterations with 38 cells sampled per patient
Key result: Median equal-gene effect was 0.268 with 85.3% positive iterations; pooled-expression effect was positive in 100% of iterations
Reader-facing interpretation: Unequal epithelial-cell counts did not explain the directional support

Analysis domain: FFPE spot QC and tumour mask
Primary setting: At least 200 detected genes and all expression-defined tumour-side spots
Alternative setting: Detected-gene thresholds of 100, 200 and 500; epithelial-high restriction
Key result: Equal-gene near-band HGP effects were 0.038, 0.059 and 0.116 across thresholds, whereas HGP differences in near-minus-deep localisation were -0.178, -0.141 and -0.079; epithelial-high masks also showed no consistent boundary effect
Reader-facing interpretation: The FFPE cohort was not treated as an independent HGP validation and did not support preferential boundary confinement

Primary setting: One to five graph hops as the near-interface band
Alternative setting: One to three and one to seven graph hops
Key result: Across 3, 5 and 7 hops, mean near-minus-deep effects were -0.016, -0.085 and -0.096 for equal-gene scores and -0.037, -0.064 and -0.059 for pooled expression; all HGP-localisation permutation P values were 0.3-0.7
Reader-facing interpretation: The absence of boundary enrichment was not created by the prespecified five-hop boundary

Key result: Equal-gene effect was 0.290 (P=0.0703) and pooled-expression effect was 0.254 (P=0.00391)
Reader-facing interpretation: The direction persisted when sparsely sampled microtumour regions were removed, with reduced exact-test resolution for the equal-gene endpoint

Key result: Equal-gene effect was 0.263 (P=0.0684) and pooled-expression effect was 0.237 (P=0.00195)
Reader-facing interpretation: The paired direction was not generated solely by pooling regions across sections
